name: CreateReadOnlyDBInstance

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符，且该参数值中不能包含非ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The region ID. The read-only instance and the primary instance must reside in the same region. You can call the DescribeRegions operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。只读实例的地域必须和主实例相同。可调用DescribeRegions获取
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The zone ID. You can call the DescribeRegions operation to query the zone ID.

*   If you use the single-zone deployment method, set this parameter to the ID of one zone. Example: `cn-hangzhou-b`.
*   If you use the multi-zone deployment method, set this parameter to the IDs of multiple zones and separate the IDs with colons (:). Example: `cn-hangzhou-b:cn-hangzhou-c`.
*   The number of zone IDs that you specify must be less than or equal to the number of nodes created for the read-only instance. If you create a read-only instance that runs RDS Basic Edition, only one node is provisioned. If you create a read-only instance that runs RDS High-availability Edition, one primary node and one secondary node are provisioned
parameters.help_zh:
可用区ID。可调用DescribeRegions获取。

- 若选择部署单可用区，填入一个可用区即可，例如`cn-hangzhou-b`。
- 若选择部署多可用区，填入多个可用区并用英文冒号（:）分隔，例如`cn-hangzhou-b:cn-hangzhou-c`。
- 填入的可用区数量应小于或等于当前创建的只读实例内的节点数。基础系列只读实例内仅含1个节点，高可用系列只读实例内含有2个节点（1个主节点与1个备节点）
parameters.name: zone_id

parameters.help_en: The primary instance ID. You can call the DescribeDBInstances operation to query the instance ID
parameters.help_zh: 主实例ID。可调用DescribeDBInstances获取
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The instance type of the read-only instance. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/145759.html. We recommend that you specify an instance type whose specifications are higher than or equal to the specifications of the instance type of the primary instance. If the specifications of the read-only instance are lower than the specifications of the primary instance, the read-only instance may encounter issues such as high latency and heavy load
parameters.help_zh: 实例规格，详见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/145759.html。建议只读实例规格不小于主实例规格，否则易导致只读实例延迟高、负载高等现象
parameters.name: db_instance_class

parameters.help_en: The storage capacity of the read-only instance. The storage capacity of the read-only instance must be greater than or equal to that of the primary instance. For more information, see the **Storage capacity** column in https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/145759.html. This value must be a multiple of 5. Unit: GB
parameters.help_zh: 存储空间，只读实例存储空间需要大于或等于主实例存储空间。取值：请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/145759.html的**存储空间**列。每5 GB进行递增，单位：GB
parameters.name: db_instance_storage

parameters.help_en:
The version of the database engine. The read-only instance and the primary instance must run the same major engine version.

*   If the read-only instance runs MySQL, set this parameter to **5.6**, **5.7**, or **8.0**.
*   If the read-only instance runs MySQL, set this parameter to **2017\_ent, 2019\_ent, or 2022\_ent**.
*   If the read-only instance runs PostgreSQL, set this parameter to **10.0, 11.0, 12.0, 13.0, 14.0, or 15.0**
parameters.help_zh:
数据库版本号。必须与主实例相同。

* MySQL数据库取值：**5.6**、**5.7**、**8.0**。
* SQL Server数据库取值：**2017_ent、2019_ent、2022_ent**。
* PostgreSQL数据库取值：**10.0、11.0、12.0、13.0、14.0、15.0**
parameters.name: engine_version

parameters.help_en:
The billing method of the read-only instance. Valid values:

*   **Postpaid**: pay-as-you-go
*   **Prepaid**: subscription
parameters.help_zh:
付费类型。取值：
* **Postpaid**：后付费（按量付费）
* **Prepaid**：预付费（包年包月）
parameters.name: pay_type

parameters.help_en:
The description of the read-only instance. The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, underscores (\_), and hyphens (-). The value must start with a letter

> The value cannot start with [http:// or https://.](http://https://。)
parameters.help_zh:
实例描述，长度为2~256个字符。以中文、英文字母开头，可以包含数字、中文、英文、下划线（_）、短横线（-）。
>不能以http://和https://开头
parameters.name: db_instance_description

parameters.help_en:
The network type of the read-only instance. Valid values:

*   **VPC**
*   **Classic**

Default value: VPC. If you set this parameter to VPC, you must also specify the **VPCId** and **VSwitchId** parameters.

>  The network type of the read-only instance can be different from the network type of the primary instance
parameters.help_zh:
只读实例的网络类型。取值：

* **VPC**：专有网络
* **Classic**：经典网络

默认创建专有网络实例，需要传入**VPCId**和**VSwitchId**。
>只读实例的网络类型可以和主实例不同
parameters.name: instance_network_type

parameters.help_en:
The virtual private cloud (VPC) ID of the read-only instance. If you leave the **InstanceNetworkType** parameter empty or set it to **VPC**, you must also specify this parameter.

> * If the primary instance uses local disks, the read-only instance and the primary instance can belong to the same VPC or different VPCs.
> * If the primary instance uses cloud disks, the read-only instance and the primary instance must belong to the same VPC
parameters.help_zh:
只读实例的专有网络VPC ID。当**InstanceNetworkType**配置为空或**VPC**时需要传入。

> * 主实例的存储类型为高性能本地盘时，只读实例可以选择任意VPC网络。
> * 主实例的存储类型为云盘时，只读实例VPC必须和主实例保持一致
parameters.name: vpc_id

parameters.help_en: The vSwitch ID of the read-only instance. If you leave the **InstanceNetworkType** parameter empty or set it to **VPC**, you must specify the VSwitchId parameter
parameters.help_zh: 只读实例的虚拟交换机ID。当**InstanceNetworkType**配置为空或**VPC**时需要传入
parameters.name: vswitch_id

parameters.help_en: The private IP address of the read-only instance. The private IP address must be within the CIDR block that is supported by the specified vSwitch. The system assigns a private IP address to the read-only instance based on the values of the **VPCId** and **VSwitchId** parameters
parameters.help_zh: 设置只读实例的内网IP，需要在指定交换机的IP地址范围内。系统默认通过**VPCId**和**VSwitchId**自动分配
parameters.name: private_ip_address

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group
parameters.help_zh: 资源组ID
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The RDS edition of the instance. Valid values:

*   **Basic**: RDS Basic Edition
*   **HighAvailability** (default): RDS High-availability Edition
*   **AlwaysOn**: RDS Cluster Edition

>  The read-only instances of the primary instance that run PostgreSQL and use cloud disks run RDS Basic Edition. Therefore, set this parameter to **Basic**
parameters.help_zh:
实例系列。取值：

* **Basic**：基础系列
* **HighAvailability**：高可用系列（默认值）
* **AlwaysOn**：集群系列

<props="china">* **Finance**：金融版</props>

>PostgreSQL云盘实例的只读实例为基础系列，因此必须传入**Basic**
parameters.name: category

parameters.help_en:
The storage type of the instance. Valid values:

*   **local_ssd**: local SSDs
*   **cloud_ssd**: standard SSDs
*   **cloud_essd**: enhanced SSDs (ESSDs) of performance level 1 (PL1)
*   **cloud_essd2**: ESSDs of PL2
*   **cloud_essd3**: ESSDs of PL3

> *   If the primary instance runs MySQL with local disks, you must set this parameter to **local_ssd**. If the primary instance runs MySQL with cloud disks, you must set this parameter to cloud_ssd, cloud_essd, cloud_essd2, or cloud_essd3.
> *   If the primary instance runs SQL Server, you must set this parameter to cloud_ssd, cloud_essd, cloud_essd2, or cloud_essd3
parameters.help_zh:
实例储存类型。取值：
* **local_ssd**：高性能本地盘
* **cloud_ssd**：SSD云盘
* **cloud_essd**：ESSD PL1云盘
* **cloud_essd2**：ESSD PL2云盘
* **cloud_essd3**：ESSD PL3云盘
* **general_essd**：高性能云盘


> * RDS MySQL主实例为高性能本地盘，则仅支持传入**local_ssd**；RDS MySQL主实例为云盘，则仅支持传入云盘存储类型。
> * SQL Server仅支持传入云盘存储类型
parameters.name: db_instance_storage_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the dedicated cluster to which the read-only instance belongs. This parameter is valid when you create the read-only instance in a dedicated cluster
parameters.help_zh: 在专属集群内创建只读实例时指定专属集群ID
parameters.name: dedicated_host_group_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the host on which the primary instance resides. This parameter is valid when you create the read-only instance in a dedicated cluster
parameters.help_zh: 在专属集群内创建只读实例时，指定主实例的主机ID
parameters.name: target_dedicated_host_id_for_master

parameters.help_en: A reserved parameter
parameters.help_zh: 备用参数，无需配置
parameters.name: gdn_instance_name

parameters.help_en: A reserved parameter
parameters.help_zh: 备用参数，无需配置
parameters.name: tddl_biz_type

parameters.help_en: A reserved parameter
parameters.help_zh: 备用参数，无需配置
parameters.name: tddl_region_config

parameters.help_en: A reserved parameter
parameters.help_zh: 备用参数，无需配置
parameters.name: instruction_set_arch

parameters.help_en:
The subscription duration of the read-only instance. Valid values:

*   If you set the **Period** parameter to **Year**, the value of the **UsedTime** parameter ranges from **1** to **5**.
*   If you set the **Period** parameter to **Month**, the value of the **UsedTime** parameter ranges from **1** to **9**.

> If you set the **PayType** parameter to **Prepaid**, you must specify the UsedTime parameter
parameters.help_zh:
指定购买时长。取值：
* 当参数**Period**为**Year**时，**UsedTime**取值为**1**~**5**。
* 当参数**Period**为**Month**时，**UsedTime**取值为**1**~**9**。

> 若**PayType**为**Prepaid**，需要传入该参数
parameters.name: used_time

parameters.help_en:
The renewal cycle of the read-only instance. Valid values:

*   **Year**
*   **Month**
parameters.help_zh:
指定预付费实例为包年或者包月类型。取值：
* **Year**：包年
* **Month**：包月
parameters.name: period

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the auto-renewal feature for the read-only instance. If you set the PayType parameter to Prepaid, you must also specify this parameter. Valid values:

*   **true**: enables the feature.
*   **false**: disables the feature.

> * If you set the Period parameter to Month, the auto-renewal cycle is one month.
> * If you set the Period parameter to Year, the auto-renewal cycle is one year
parameters.help_zh:
实例是否自动续费，仅在创建包年包月实例时传入。取值：
* **true**：是
* **false**：否

> * 按月购买，则自动续费周期为1个月。
> * 按年购买，则自动续费周期为1年
parameters.name: auto_renew

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the release protection feature for the read-only instance. Valid values:

*   **true**
*   **false** (default)

>  You can enable the release protection feature for the read-only instance only when you set the **PayType** parameter to **Postpaid**
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启RDS释放保护功能。取值：
* **true**：开启
* **false**：关闭（默认值）

> 仅**计费方式**为**按量付费**时支持开启
parameters.name: deletion_protection

parameters.help_en:
The port that can be initialized when you create a read-only ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL instance.

Valid values: 1000 to 65534
parameters.help_zh:
支持在RDS MySQL主实例创建只读实例时初始化端口。

取值范围：1000~65534
parameters.name: port

parameters.help_en: The BpeEnabled
parameters.help_zh: 弃用参数，无需配置
parameters.name: bpe_enabled

parameters.help_en: An invalid parameter. You do not need to specify this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2340501.html的IO性能突发功能开关。取值：
* **true**：开启
* **false**：关闭
parameters.name: bursting_enabled

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to create a DuckDB analytic instance. Valid values:

- **true**: Enabled
- **false**: Disabled

> Currently, only RDS MySQL and RDS PostgreSQL support creating DuckDB analytic instances
parameters.help_zh:
是否创建DuckDB分析实例。取值：

- **true**：开启
- **false**：关闭

> 当前仅RDS MySQL和RDS PostgreSQL支持创建DuckDB分析实例
parameters.name: is_analytic_read_only_ins

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to automatically complete the payment. Valid values:

1.  **true**: automatically completes the payment. Make sure that your account balance is sufficient.
2.  **false**: does not automatically complete the payment. An unpaid order is generated.

>  Default value: true. If your account balance is insufficient, you can set the AutoPay parameter to false to generate an unpaid order. Then, you can log on to the ApsaraDB RDS console to complete the payment
parameters.help_zh:
是否自动支付。取值：

- **true**：自动支付。您需要确保账户余额充足。
- **false**：只生成订单不扣费。




> 默认值为true。如果您的支付方式余额不足，可以将参数AutoPay设置为false，此时会生成未支付订单，您可以登录RDS管理控制台自行支付。
>
parameters.name: auto_pay

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to automatically create database proxies. Valid values:

*   **true**: automatically creates database proxies. By default, general-purpose database proxies are created.
*   **false**: does not automatically create database proxies
parameters.help_zh:
是否自动创建代理。取值：

- **true**：开启自动创建，默认为通用代理。

- **false**：不开启自动创建
parameters.name: auto_create_proxy

parameters.help_en: A reserved parameter
parameters.help_zh:
高性能云盘的https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2527067.html功能开关。取值：

 - **1**：开启
 - **0**：不开启
parameters.name: io_acceleration_enabled

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to use a coupon. Valid values:

*   **true**: uses a coupon.
*   **false** (default): does not use a coupon
parameters.help_zh:
是否使用代金券。取值：
* **true**：使用代金券。
* **false**（默认）：不使用代金券
parameters.name: auto_use_coupon

parameters.help_zh: 优惠券code

v1_parameters.name: DBInstanceStorage

v1_parameters.help_en:
The storage type of the instance. Valid values:

*   **local_ssd**: local SSDs
*   **cloud_ssd**: standard SSDs
*   **cloud_essd**: enhanced SSDs (ESSDs) of performance level 1 (PL1)
*   **cloud_essd2**: ESSDs of PL2
*   **cloud_essd3**: ESSDs of PL3

> *   If the primary instance runs MySQL with local disks, you must set this parameter to **local_ssd**. If the primary instance runs MySQL with cloud disks, you must set this parameter to cloud_ssd, cloud_essd, cloud_essd2, or cloud_essd3.
> *   If the primary instance runs SQL Server, you must set this parameter to cloud_ssd, cloud_essd, cloud_essd2, or cloud_essd3
v1_parameters.help_zh:
实例储存类型。取值：
* **local_ssd**：高性能本地盘
* **cloud_ssd**：SSD云盘
* **cloud_essd**：ESSD PL1云盘
* **cloud_essd2**：ESSD PL2云盘
* **cloud_essd3**：ESSD PL3云盘
* **general_essd**：高性能云盘


> * RDS MySQL主实例为高性能本地盘，则仅支持传入**local_ssd**；RDS MySQL主实例为云盘，则仅支持传入云盘存储类型。
> * SQL Server仅支持传入云盘存储类型
v1_parameters.name: DBInstanceStorageType

v1_parameters.help_en: The ID of the dedicated cluster to which the read-only instance belongs. This parameter is valid when you create the read-only instance in a dedicated cluster
v1_parameters.help_zh: 在专属集群内创建只读实例时指定专属集群ID
v1_parameters.name: DedicatedHostGroupId

v1_parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the release protection feature for the read-only instance. Valid values:

*   **true**
*   **false** (default)

>  You can enable the release protection feature for the read-only instance only when you set the **PayType** parameter to **Postpaid**
v1_parameters.help_zh:
是否开启RDS释放保护功能。取值：
* **true**：开启
* **false**：关闭（默认值）

> 仅**计费方式**为**按量付费**时支持开启
v1_parameters.name: DeletionProtection

v1_parameters.help_en:
The version of the database engine. The read-only instance and the primary instance must run the same major engine version.

*   If the read-only instance runs MySQL, set this parameter to **5.6**, **5.7**, or **8.0**.
*   If the read-only instance runs MySQL, set this parameter to **2017\_ent, 2019\_ent, or 2022\_ent**.
*   If the read-only instance runs PostgreSQL, set this parameter to **10.0, 11.0, 12.0, 13.0, 14.0, or 15.0**
v1_parameters.help_zh:
数据库版本号。必须与主实例相同。

* MySQL数据库取值：**5.6**、**5.7**、**8.0**。
* SQL Server数据库取值：**2017_ent、2019_ent、2022_ent**。
* PostgreSQL数据库取值：**10.0、11.0、12.0、13.0、14.0、15.0**
v1_parameters.name: EngineVersion

v1_parameters.help_en: A reserved parameter
v1_parameters.help_zh: 备用参数，无需配置
v1_parameters.name: GdnInstanceName

v1_parameters.help_en:
The network type of the read-only instance. Valid values:

*   **VPC**
*   **Classic**

Default value: VPC. If you set this parameter to VPC, you must also specify the **VPCId** and **VSwitchId** parameters.

>  The network type of the read-only instance can be different from the network type of the primary instance
v1_parameters.help_zh:
只读实例的网络类型。取值：

* **VPC**：专有网络
* **Classic**：经典网络

默认创建专有网络实例，需要传入**VPCId**和**VSwitchId**。
>只读实例的网络类型可以和主实例不同
v1_parameters.name: InstanceNetworkType

v1_parameters.help_en: A reserved parameter
v1_parameters.help_zh: 备用参数，无需配置
v1_parameters.name: InstructionSetArch

v1_parameters.help_en: A reserved parameter
v1_parameters.help_zh:
高性能云盘的https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2527067.html功能开关。取值：

 - **1**：开启
 - **0**：不开启
v1_parameters.name: IoAccelerationEnabled

v1_parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to create a DuckDB analytic instance. Valid values:

- **true**: Enabled
- **false**: Disabled

> Currently, only RDS MySQL and RDS PostgreSQL support creating DuckDB analytic instances
v1_parameters.help_zh:
是否创建DuckDB分析实例。取值：

- **true**：开启
- **false**：关闭

> 当前仅RDS MySQL和RDS PostgreSQL支持创建DuckDB分析实例
v1_parameters.name: IsAnalyticReadOnlyIns

v1_parameters.help_en:
The billing method of the read-only instance. Valid values:

*   **Postpaid**: pay-as-you-go
*   **Prepaid**: subscription
v1_parameters.help_zh:
付费类型。取值：
* **Postpaid**：后付费（按量付费）
* **Prepaid**：预付费（包年包月）
v1_parameters.name: PayType

v1_parameters.help_en:
The renewal cycle of the read-only instance. Valid values:

*   **Year**
*   **Month**
v1_parameters.help_zh:
指定预付费实例为包年或者包月类型。取值：
* **Year**：包年
* **Month**：包月
v1_parameters.name: Period

v1_parameters.help_en:
The port that can be initialized when you create a read-only ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL instance.

Valid values: 1000 to 65534
v1_parameters.help_zh:
支持在RDS MySQL主实例创建只读实例时初始化端口。

取值范围：1000~65534
v1_parameters.name: Port

v1_parameters.help_en: The private IP address of the read-only instance. The private IP address must be within the CIDR block that is supported by the specified vSwitch. The system assigns a private IP address to the read-only instance based on the values of the **VPCId** and **VSwitchId** parameters
v1_parameters.help_zh: 设置只读实例的内网IP，需要在指定交换机的IP地址范围内。系统默认通过**VPCId**和**VSwitchId**自动分配
v1_parameters.name: PrivateIpAddress

v1_parameters.help_en: The coupon code
v1_parameters.help_zh: 优惠券code
v1_parameters.name: PromotionCode

v1_parameters.help_en: The region ID. The read-only instance and the primary instance must reside in the same region. You can call the DescribeRegions operation to query the most recent region list
v1_parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。只读实例的地域必须和主实例相同。可调用DescribeRegions获取
v1_parameters.name: RegionId

v1_parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group
v1_parameters.help_zh: 资源组ID
v1_parameters.name: ResourceGroupId

v1_parameters.help_en: The ID of the host on which the primary instance resides. This parameter is valid when you create the read-only instance in a dedicated cluster
v1_parameters.help_zh: 在专属集群内创建只读实例时，指定主实例的主机ID
v1_parameters.name: TargetDedicatedHostIdForMaster

v1_parameters.help_en: A reserved parameter
v1_parameters.help_zh: 备用参数，无需配置
v1_parameters.name: TddlBizType

v1_parameters.help_en: A reserved parameter
v1_parameters.help_zh: 备用参数，无需配置
v1_parameters.name: TddlRegionConfig

v1_parameters.help_en:
The subscription duration of the read-only instance. Valid values:

*   If you set the **Period** parameter to **Year**, the value of the **UsedTime** parameter ranges from **1** to **5**.
*   If you set the **Period** parameter to **Month**, the value of the **UsedTime** parameter ranges from **1** to **9**.

> If you set the **PayType** parameter to **Prepaid**, you must specify the UsedTime parameter
v1_parameters.help_zh:
指定购买时长。取值：
* 当参数**Period**为**Year**时，**UsedTime**取值为**1**~**5**。
* 当参数**Period**为**Month**时，**UsedTime**取值为**1**~**9**。

> 若**PayType**为**Prepaid**，需要传入该参数
v1_parameters.name: UsedTime

v1_parameters.help_en:
The virtual private cloud (VPC) ID of the read-only instance. If you leave the **InstanceNetworkType** parameter empty or set it to **VPC**, you must also specify this parameter.

> * If the primary instance uses local disks, the read-only instance and the primary instance can belong to the same VPC or different VPCs.
> * If the primary instance uses cloud disks, the read-only instance and the primary instance must belong to the same VPC
v1_parameters.help_zh:
只读实例的专有网络VPC ID。当**InstanceNetworkType**配置为空或**VPC**时需要传入。

> * 主实例的存储类型为高性能本地盘时，只读实例可以选择任意VPC网络。
> * 主实例的存储类型为云盘时，只读实例VPC必须和主实例保持一致
v1_parameters.name: VPCId

v1_parameters.help_en: The vSwitch ID of the read-only instance. If you leave the **InstanceNetworkType** parameter empty or set it to **VPC**, you must specify the VSwitchId parameter
v1_parameters.help_zh: 只读实例的虚拟交换机ID。当**InstanceNetworkType**配置为空或**VPC**时需要传入
v1_parameters.name: VSwitchId

v1_parameters.help_en:
The zone ID. You can call the DescribeRegions operation to query the zone ID.

*   If you use the single-zone deployment method, set this parameter to the ID of one zone. Example: `cn-hangzhou-b`.
*   If you use the multi-zone deployment method, set this parameter to the IDs of multiple zones and separate the IDs with colons (:). Example: `cn-hangzhou-b:cn-hangzhou-c`.
*   The number of zone IDs that you specify must be less than or equal to the number of nodes created for the read-only instance. If you create a read-only instance that runs RDS Basic Edition, only one node is provisioned. If you create a read-only instance that runs RDS High-availability Edition, one primary node and one secondary node are provisioned
v1_parameters.help_zh:
可用区ID。可调用DescribeRegions获取。

- 若选择部署单可用区，填入一个可用区即可，例如`cn-hangzhou-b`。
- 若选择部署多可用区，填入多个可用区并用英文冒号（:）分隔，例如`cn-hangzhou-b:cn-hangzhou-c`。
- 填入的可用区数量应小于或等于当前创建的只读实例内的节点数。基础系列只读实例内仅含1个节点，高可用系列只读实例内含有2个节点（1个主节点与1个备节点）
v1_parameters.name: ZoneId
